title: Addagada Raghavamma v. Anchalu Chenchamma

content.caseIdentity: Addagada Raghavamma v. Anchalu Chenchamma, AIR 1964 SC 136
content.holding: Constitution Bench ruling establishing the classic distinction between burden of proof and onus of proof: the legal burden of establishing a case remains permanently on the party asserting it and never shifts, whereas the evidential onus of adducing evidence shifts from stage to stage during trial.
content.relevance: The foundational locus classicus on Section 104 BSA allocation of burden.
